label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: After pressing the decline button on the cookie banner nothing was announced and the banner stayed in the tree for a moment, so I could not tell it had closed.

The home page has dozens of unlabeled-looking Previous and Next links and repeated color radio groups between products, making the product list very noisy; two products share the same name with no way to tell them apart.

element.name: RIB KNIT TEE Regular price $39.00 CAD

findings.problem: Six unnamed links sit before the product title, so I could not tell what they were (probably image gallery).
Size radios give no stock information, and selecting a size gave no announcement.
After Add to cart the button just became disabled with no message; the cart dialog only showed up on a later read, so I did not know the item was added.
The cart quantity buttons are links not buttons, and the country defaults to Canada while the goal asked for the United States.
